line 2 is the one worth reading: synthesised clicks moved the mock room 1-14 -> 1-17 -> 1-16 -> 1-15 -> 1-14, so the pressed connection into request_visible_exit is NOT dead, which the 5 September record could not establish. Which button was pressed could not be attributed, so nothing is claimed about it.

why not: PowerShell 5.1 is DPI-unaware by default - measured on one window seconds apart, IsProcessDPIAware False reported client 1024x576 origin 2048,271 and True reported 3840x2071 origin 0,29 - and in one run the cursor moved between SetCursorPos and the press (asked for screen 360,375; GetCursorPos reported 1515,19 a second later). A rig steering the shared cursor on this machine cannot tell its own click from anyone else's.

instrument finding worth more than the line it came from: Graphics.CopyFromScreen captures the GPU-composited Godot window that PrintWindow could not, which unblocks every visual check the 5 September record had to abandon. tools/capture-godot-window.ps1 aborts rather than shooting if the window is not foreground or the client rect is implausibly small.
